newsitem.title: EGYPT: Cairo bourse shares and volume mostly stable.
newsitem.headline: Cairo bourse shares and volume mostly stable.

text.p: Egyptian share prices and volumes were mostly stable on Tuesday in a range of stocks.
The Capital Market Authority index shed 0.02 points to 333.53 in trade of 42.7 million pounds ($12.5 million).
Commercial International Bank/CIB led the way in the financial sector, trading in shares worth 8.7 million pounds while its stock closed 1.55 pounds up at 74.02.

"CIB is extremely demanded," said broker Sarah Gamal of EFG Hermes. The bank announced its results on Sunday, saying that net profits for the first half of the 1997 calendar year, the bank's financial year, were 133.7 million pounds compared to 122 million in the previous period.
Medinet Nasr Housing and Development performed well for the third straight day, with volume worth 6.3 million pounds. Its share slipped 0.98 pounds to close at 238.7.
East Delta Flour Mills showed the highest number of shares traded in the milling sector, with more than 19,500 changing hands. Its price slid 0.22 to 58.55 pounds.

Eipico/Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries was active again on Tuesday after registering the most activity on Monday. Shares worth 2.06 million pounds were traded. The stock rose a fraction, up 0.02 to 206.95 pounds.
"Pharmaceuticals are basically doing well," said Gamal.
Amriyah Cement was the most active cement stock, closing 0.08 higher at 79.8 pounds in 2.06 million pounds trade.
"Amriyah is extremely demanded by foreigners," said Gamal.
The index for openly traded firms rose to 449.54 points from 445.19 points on Monday and that for the rarely traded "closed" firms fell to 248.63 from 249.82.
Of the 95 shares traded, 43 rose, 38 ended lower and 14 remained unchanged.
